notes.title: Magenta Horizon - Neverending Harvest is OUT
notes.content:
After 4 and half years of a teeth-grinding journey of solo-development, Magenta Horizon has become a complete work.
Here's a list of contents of this final form. 

<Length>
[list]
[*] About 15-20 hours to finish on your first play through of Wraith(default) difficulty.
[*] Character can use all the different techniques from the start, so depending on the player's knowledge, it can be vastly shortened.
[*] More play times will be driven from mastering the combat and getting the better scores.
[/list]

<Stages>
[list]
[*] Total Three Acts. 
[*] 6 Linear combat-oriented stages
[*] 13 Non-linear exploration+combat stages
[*] 11 Main-line boss-specific stages
[*] 3 Hidden boss stages
[/list]

<Enemies>
[list]
[*] Total 65 Enemies in the Codex
[*] Total 19 Bosses, with two remixed re-fights and three hidden ones
[*] Total 46 normal chess pieces and two of them are minor version of some of the main bosses
[*] All the bosses and about half of the chess pieces get additional patterns or different AI flow on Reaper(+) difficulties
[/list]

<Achievements>
[list]
[*] Total 51 Steam Achievements on launch
[/list]

<Attack Options>
[list]
[*] Total 1 Melee Weapons, 10 Ranged Skills
[*] Hard to calculate the exact moveset number because of the web-like combo structure, but about 50+ melee movement branches can be weaved with just one weapon combat system
8 Ranged Skills can interact each other and create about 10+ different unique combinations
[/list]

<Necklace Pieces (buff items)>
[list]
[*] Total 28 Necklace Pieces
[*] 17 can be found from explorations and beating the challenge rooms
[*] 10 can be purchased from the in-game store
[*] Only one of them can be obtained by completing a certain side mission
[/list]

<Additional Modes>
[list]
[*] Boss Rush (Fully unlocks after finding all the bosses) 
[*] Horde Mode (Opened from the start) 
[/list]

<New QoL Features>
[list]
[*] Controller rumbling
[*] 4 localization supports. English, Korean, Portuguese (BR), and Russian.
[*] Better tutorial segment
[*] Much better-written dialogues
[/list]


[To-do list]
[list]
[*] More localization coming soon
[*] Full album will be updated within this weekend
[/list]

notes.title: 2024/10/31 Halloween content update + bug fixes.
notes.content:
Happy Halloween, reapers! Here are some patch notes. 
[list]
[*] A boss stage 10-3 is added. Just to give a closure to stage 10 before the final release.
[*] Added the body part destruction mechanic to the boss in 7-2.
[*] Lower the number of spewing goo pools in the boss room in 7-2 below Reaper difficulty.
[*] Fixed a bug where Harvest of Focus didn't do a shit. ....Yes, you heard that right. Harvest of Focus hasn't been working for the whole development time. Instead, the focus gain was activated by Harvest of Life. It really shows my developer skill.
[*] From now on maintaining over S rank makes you charge up all the focus meters automatically (on every difficulty). Nesting Focus enhances that effect.
[*] Enhanced the Dread Vines HP threshold to match the critical health indicator. (30% of the normal health is where the indicator starts blinking)
[/list]

notes.title: The Stygian Update
notes.content:
Magenta Horizon's 0.9 Version Update is finally here! It's time to plunge into the abyss to get the job done... 
And the story is getting closer to the grand finale.

[b][Added contents][/b]

- Stage 10-1 and Stage 10-2
- 2 new enemies
- 1 new boss
- 1 new necklace piece (and now it is a whole!) 
- Horde Mode is in the extra tab, and the ranking board is included!

[b][Changes for the base game][/b]

- Adjusted some hitbox sizes of Gretel's moveset in an advantageous way.
- The starting-animation of the aerial XY combo is significantly shortened.  
- Ranged supporters of the 3-3 boss on Reaper difficulty show up slightly later.
- Carpet bombing pattern of 8-1 boss is slightly nerfed and it will always chain into a vertical strike attack. 
- 8-1's big optional combat arena is fully constructed(you can get an apt achievement for clearing this), and an additional arena will show up on Reaper and higher difficulties. 
- Boss rush mode's segments are properly segregated by the act numbers. 
- Current Act 3 bosses are implemented in the boss rush mode.

notes.title: Drenched In Gold

Magenta Horizon's 0.8 Version Update is finally here! Plunge into the piles of jewelry, Get ass-kicked by the demons and dangerous carnival rides, and Nail-down the JACKPOT!

[Added contents]

[list]
[*] First Half of Act 3 (5 stages)
[*] 9 new mob enemies compared to the 0.7 version
[*] 3 new bosses
[*] 6 new necklace pieces
[*] 2 new ranged skills
[/list]

[list]

[*] You can see your damage number when you are fighting training dummies in the training room.

[*] Horrendous Beast's attack speed is slightly reduced. 
[*] Rewrote some dialogues to make the protagonist more....... German.

[Bug fixes]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Cyclone Blades can bounce off weirdly if they collide at corners.
[*] Fixed a bug where healing orbs healed the player more than they should.

[/list]

[NOTES]

[list]
[*] Currently the boss rush mode doesn't include the new boss lineups because act 3 bosses are planned to be added in a bunch.

[*] If you haven't tried the game again on higher difficulties, or lost the muscle memories while waiting for the update, I highly recommend playing it on the later levels of Act 2 first, as Act 3's difficulty curve won't give a break for returning players, and the story is continuous from the end of Act 2. (it could work as a recap)

[/list]

notes.title: 2023-12-24 Version 0.7.16 patch + Letter of thanks
notes.content:
[b][Players, You have my thanks.][/b]

Before this year wraps up, I want to show my gratitude towards the audience.
This game isn't the most intuitive thing you will ever find in the market.
The tutorials are rough, the visuals and music are both noisy and the obstacles don’t wait for their turns and rush at you. It would have been an intimidating experience for most people. 
Yet you guys bought the idea and some of you really loved it.
As a solo developer who wants to develop a game that I would enjoy the most, it's an amazing experience to know that there are plenty of people who share a similar fun-sensor. 
This year marks a special year for me because of that. Thank you so much, and have a nice holiday. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42774589/b6b50abdf333903dddc21d0941adbfd4b2bca5dc.png[/img]

[b][Upcoming Act 3.][/b]

Act 3 development is still going on. If the flow of development goes on as I planned, the first half of Act 3 will be released around the early part of next year. Here's a little combat arena as a showcase. Trust me on this one, this level won't hold back punches. 

[previewyoutube=4l-CKn5v2vA;full][/previewyoutube]


[b][Oh yeah, The patch note..][/b]
  
This will be the last patch for this year. It only consists of nerfs and balancing. Not a good Christmas gift, I know... but it has to be done. 

- All the time limits and total style requirements for all the stages have been adjusted (to be tighter) on Reaper difficulty. 
- Melee-based attacks will give a reduced amount of style bonus as a baseline. (Except for the hook attack)
- The stinger-to-swirling-uppercut move (Grounded-Down-Heavy => Heavy combo) now has a slightly-delayed starting lag. 

I'll see you next year.
Thank you very much, Vielen Dank, 감사합니다.

- Fitting to the change, Descending Falcon has a different buff now. (Activates hyper armor and increases the damage of the non-fully-charged release)

notes.title: [0.7.14 Version Patch Note]
notes.content:
Halloween is near, so I have some scary updates for you all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42774589/cc28620fae682f9af5f44e50388ff629d4f1849b.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Since "that CEO" is gone, I removed the splash screen joke as I promised.
[*] The game used to have a strict set of normal damage and heavy damage from the enemy's side. From now on, each enemy's attack will have a set amount of damage multipliers. This was added for future balancing and conceptual consistency. (for example, there should be a damage difference between getting smacked by a lobster and getting crashed by a train.)
[*] This also means, that some enemies will deal more damage and some enemies will deal less. But overall they will provide the same playstyle to beat them.
[*] Buffed the health of bosses in 2-3 and 3-3.
[*] Added more necklace inventory slots to provide more collectibles in the future. (There are no new necklace pieces yet!)
[*] Completely removed the boss's post-attack delays in Still Alive and Wandering Soul difficulty modes.
[*] Added the warning signal around the health bar which appears when the health is low.
[/list]

notes.title: Magenta Horizon 🦉 in Early Access May 29th
notes.content:
It's been a long road, working continually with the [b]Magenta Horizon[/b] fanbase to polish and improve Act 1, while also onboarding that feedback to improve the rest of the game as well. And FINALLY it's time to share that Magenta Horizon will be entering Early Access on [u][b]MAY 29th, 2023![/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=UBn87-WmuPQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]ABOUT[/h3]
[b]Magenta Horizon[/b] is a fast-paced 2D action platformer, with gameplay inspired by spectacle fighters, and a world designed to look and feel like a living prog-rock album cover. Test your skill with it's vast, stylistic, expressive combat options!

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]
🦉 The 'Character Action Game' genre reborn
🎮 2D action platformer
🤺 Expressive combat
👿 EPIC bosses
🎸 Prog-rock inspired art style
💥 Flexible difficulty options

[h3]LAUNCH[/h3]
The game will launch in English only (for now!) and will be available for only [b]$10.99[/b] with a launch discount on top of that! Please be sure to [b]WISHLIST[/b] the game so you don't miss out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109060/Magenta_Horizon/

[h3]UPDATE[/h3]
A new update has also recently been rolled out in preparation for our Early Access launch:

- [b]Every horn pick-ups will be AUTOMATIC (You don't need to go near the dropped items) from now on.[/b]
- Adjusted the camera distance for every boss fights.
- Several encounters are modified with the new enemies and new weapons in consideration
- Blucher's body collider is adjusted to fit the animation.
- Summoned Wraith Heart spike now gets affected by gravity. (no more hovering spike)
- There's an input delay for dialogue click so there won't be any accidental line skip.
